highlights.reason_zh: 权限、审计和成本账本进入同一 multi-agent 控制面，直接影响团队如何安全扩展 agent。
highlights.reason_en: Permissions, auditing and cost ledgers now share one multi-agent control plane, directly affecting safe scaling.

highlights.reason_zh: 开放权重让敏感 DNA 可以留在本地，但厂商 benchmark 不能替代临床验证。
highlights.reason_en: Open weights keep sensitive DNA local, but publisher benchmarks do not substitute for clinical validation.

highlights.reason_zh: 33B/512K 开放权重给本地长上下文多一个候选，代价与有效长度仍需实测。
highlights.reason_en: Open 33B/512K weights add a local long-context option whose cost and effective length still need testing.

highlights.reason_zh: 共享失败账本把多轮 agent 重试变成可复现的工程实验，而不是只靠增加 coordinator。
highlights.reason_en: A shared failure ledger makes multi-pass agent retries reproducible without simply adding another coordinator.

highlights.reason_zh: 远程成本表故障曾让 gateway 无法启动；修复直接关系到离线和受限网络环境的可用性。
highlights.reason_en: A remote cost-map outage could stop the gateway from starting; the fix directly affects constrained-network reliability.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功，并补查开源仓库、Hugging Face、论文、中文团队及重大综合新闻。6 条为召回或周度补漏，不代表今天才发生；厂商 benchmark 尚待独立复现。OpenAI 10 月 24 日日期级更新因缺少时分，仍无法越过上一 checkpoint 精确归窗。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded, supplemented by open-source repositories, Hugging Face, papers, Chinese teams and major general news. Six items are recall or weekly gap recoveries and did not necessarily happen today; publisher benchmarks remain independently unverified. Date-only OpenAI API updates from October 24 still cannot be placed precisely across the prior checkpoint.
